sources.title: How Much Does an Alternator Replacement Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: found most alternator replacements cost $259-$491 including parts and labor.

sources.title: Cost of an Alternator Replacement (2026)
sources.quote: The cost of replacing an alternator ranges from $750 to $1,000 on average, though costs could exceed $3,000 for performance models or hard-to-access engines.

prices.name: Brake fluid flush (exchange)
prices.includes: Old brake fluid drained and the system bled with new fluid; independent shops about $110-$160, dealers $140-$220; usually due every 2-3 years (typical = independent-shop midpoint)

sources.title: How Much Does a Brake Fluid Replacement Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: For most drivers, a standard brake fluid flush with a full system bleed lands around $110–$160 at independent shops and $140–$220 at dealerships.

sources.title: Why Are Brake Fluid Changes Important? | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: For the most part, you can expect a brake fluid change to cost somewhere between $80 and $200.

sources.title: Why You Need a Brake Fluid Flush And What It Costs
sources.quote: The average brake fluid flush cost is typically $75 to $250. The price includes both parts and labor.

prices.name: Replace brake pads (one axle)
prices.includes: Pads only, parts and labor for one axle (typical = midpoint)

sources.title: How Much Does a Brake Pad Replacement Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: we’ve found that most drivers pay about $148–$216 per axle for brake pad replacement.

sources.title: Cost to Replace Brake Pads and Rotors (2026 Guide)
sources.quote: If you only need to replace your brake pads, expect to spend around $335 to $394 per axle on average.

prices.name: Replace brake pads and rotors (one axle)
prices.includes: Pads and rotors for one axle, parts and labor (typical = midpoint)

sources.title: Cost to Replace Brake Pads and Rotors (2026 Guide)
sources.quote: The cost of replacing brake pads and rotors at the same time averages $909 to $1,092 per axle.

prices.name: Resurface (machine) brake rotors (one axle)
prices.includes: Machining both rotors on one axle at a shop that removes and refits them; some shops include it with a pad job. A rotor below its minimum thickness must be replaced instead (typical = middle of the $80-$120 shop price)

sources.title: How Much Does Resurfacing Brake Rotors Cost?
sources.quote: If a repair shop must remove, machine, inspect, and reinstall the rotors, a practical budget is about $100 to $200+ per axle.

sources.title: Brake Lathe vs Rotor Replacement: 2026 Cost Analysis for Auto Shops - Best Buy Automotive Equipment
sources.quote: Customer pricing shows an even starker contrast: $300-$600 per axle for pad and rotor replacement versus $80-$120 for resurfacing service.

sources.title: Should I Replace or Resurface My Car's Brake Rotors?
sources.quote: The average cost for resurfacing brake rotors is between $20 to $40 for each brake rotor. If the shop is already performing a brake pad replacement, this might be included in the service.

prices.name: Replace the cabin air filter
prices.includes: Filter and 15 minutes to 1 hour of shop labor (typical = midpoint)

sources.title: Cabin Air Filter Replacement Cost Estimate - Jerry
sources.quote: This means, in total, it’ll likely cost you between about $40 to $231 to have your filter replaced by a mechanic.

prices.name: Car A/C recharge
prices.includes: Recharge and leak check; newer R-1234yf cars cost more (typical = midpoint)

sources.title: How Much Does an A/C Recharge Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: found a typical car A/C recharge costs about $205–$212 for cars that use the older, common refrigerant (R-134a) and around $250–$500 (or more) for cars that use the newer, more eco-friendly refrigerant (R-1234yf), which is more expensive.

sources.title: Cost of Car AC Repair (2026)
sources.quote: Average estimates for recharging the air conditioners in our sample vehicles ranged from $430 to $521.

prices.name: Replace a car battery
prices.includes: Battery, installation and disposal of the old one (typical = midpoint)

sources.title: How Much Does a Car Battery Replacement Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: you can expect the cost of a new, professionally installed car battery to be between $268–$368.

prices.name: Diagnostic fee (check engine light testing)
prices.includes: Testing to find why the check engine light is on, not the repair itself; parts stores read codes free, and many shops credit the fee toward the repair (typical = midpoint of basic testing)

sources.title: When To Consult A Certified Mechanic | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: RepairPal estimates that basic check engine light testing and diagnosis cost $88 to $144.

sources.title: Common Symptoms of Failing Ignition Coils - Jerry
sources.quote: Expect a $120 to $200 diagnostic fee; ask for the scan report.

sources.title: "Check Engine" Tips On How To Handle It | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: National chains like Autozone can run a free diagnostic on your engine when the light comes on, typically costing up to $100 at a local mechanic.

prices.name: Coolant flush (cooling system / radiator flush)

sources.title: How Much Does a Cooling System Flush Cost? - Jerry
sources.quote: the average cooling system flush price (also called a coolant flush or radiator flush) runs $173–$184 at most shops. A basic drain-and-fill (no machine flush) often costs $80–$150

sources.title: Cost of a Radiator Flush - Car Repair and Maintenance - CostHelper
sources.quote: Expect to pay $40-$200 to have a radiator flushed, depending on the age, make and model of the vehicle

sources.title: Top 10 Affordable Car Repairs | Endurance Warranty
sources.quote: Price Range: $30-60 for DIY supplies; $265-$402 for professional flush and fill
